scientific_integrity: The uniform proof gives a direct colon computation, a path-cover bijection and a forbidden-word generating function; the verifier separately enumerates small cases. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The ideal classification concerns S_m={0} union [m,2m-3] union [2m,infinity), integer m>=4, not all numerical semigroups. Case checks at m=4,...,12 are not an infinite proof. Earlier equivalent unindexed research remains possible.
title: Divisorial-ideal lattice of two-gap near-ordinary numerical semigroups
